title: The Tate twist line is a rank-one lisse adic sheaf and twisting is the lisse tensor
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime and let $X$ be a separated noetherian scheme of finite dimension on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $m\in\mathbf Z$. For a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi_E$ and $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], let $T_{E,n}=A_{E,n,X}(m)$ be the étale Tate sheaf of [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-sheaf] on the small étale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], formed with $N=\ell^n$ (which kills $A_{E,n}$). Then:

1. Reduction modulo $\varpi_E^n$ (with $u\mapsto u^\ell$ on roots of unity, and for $m<0$ through the dual) gives isomorphisms $T_{E,n+1}\otimes_{A_{E,n+1}}A_{E,n}\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{E,n}$, and each $T_{E,n}$ is étale locally isomorphic to the constant sheaf $A_{E,n,X}$. Hence $\mathcal T_E=(T_{E,n})_{n\ge1}$ is a lisse $\mathcal O_E$-sheaf of rank one in the sense of [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], and $\mathcal T=(E,\mathcal T_E\otimes E)$ is a lisse $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-sheaf whose fibre $\mathcal T_{\bar x}$ [def-pod-lisse-adic-fibre-functors] at every geometric point $\bar x$ of $X$ [def-weil-geometric-point] is a one-dimensional $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-vector space; up to canonical isomorphism $\mathcal T$ does not depend on $E$.

2. With $\nu_X:X_{\mathrm{proet}}\to X_{\mathrm{et}}$ the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], there are isomorphisms $\nu_X^{*}T_{E,n}\cong A_{E,n}(m)_X$ with the finite-level twists of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], compatible with the transition maps, and $\varprojlim_n\nu_X^{*}T_{E,n}\cong\mathcal O_E(m)_X$. Thus the object of $D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] given by $\mathcal T$ in degree zero, namely $\mathcal O_E(m)_X$ rationalized and taken at the finite stage $E$, is the twist object $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}(m)$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed].

3. For every $K\in D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ the Tate twist $K(m)=K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\Lambda(m)$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] is naturally isomorphic to the tensor product $K\otimes^L\mathcal T$ of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] (the completed integral tensor product, rationalized and extended to a common finite stage); in particular, on an integral representative the uncompleted derived tensor product with the invertible line $\mathcal O_E(m)_X$ is already derived complete and agrees with the completed one.
